findings.evidence: `Function.comp_def` is the repo's own idiom for this rewrite — e.g. `TauCeti/Probability/Exchangeability/JointPathLaw.lean:84` (`simp only [Function.comp_def, prefixProjPair_apply]`), plus ~dozens of other uses under `TauCeti/`.
findings.fix: Use the explicit lemma: `rw [← Function.comp_def f (fun x : ℕ → α => x i), ← AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable ..., hmap i]` (or `simp only [← Function.comp_def]` first).
findings.issue: `rw [show (fun x : ℕ → α => f (x i)) = f ∘ fun x : ℕ → α => x i from rfl, ...]` closes a function equality by definitional unfolding of `Function.comp`, with no comment justifying it; it is the only `show`/`rfl` defeq step in the PR.

findings.evidence: ProbabilityMeasure.lean:55-57 and ConditionallyIID/StrongLaw.lean:118-120 are the same three lines; the former is exactly the ∀-quantified form of the latter.
findings.fix: Expose it once in the new `TauCeti/MeasureTheory/Integral/ProbabilityMeasure.lean` (e.g. `theorem integrable_of_abs_le (hf : Measurable f) (hbdd : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ C) (P : ProbabilityMeasure α) : Integrable f (P : Measure α)`), use it for `hint` in `measurable_probabilityMeasure_integral`, and call it here — that file is already imported at line 14.
findings.issue: `Integrable.of_bound hf.aestronglyMeasurable C (.of_forall fun x => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbdd x)` is duplicated verbatim from `TauCeti/MeasureTheory/Integral/ProbabilityMeasure.lean:55-57`; the reusable fact (a bounded measurable `f` is integrable against every `ProbabilityMeasure`) stays hidden inside two proofs, and is already needed twice on day one.

summary: Proofs are mostly robust and well-commented, but one step closes a function-equality by an undocumented `show ... from rfl` where `Function.comp_def` is available, and the bounded-implies-integrable derivation is duplicated verbatim in two of the new files instead of being exposed as a lemma.
